name: runtime
summary: Independent ARM64 Darwin runtime libraries (libSystem provider and dyld) built from the pinned PureDarwin snapshot with source-built compiler-rt builtins from pinned llvm-project.

license.notes: Mixed. puredarwin-vm-next component notices apply (APSL-2.0/BSD families); the llvm-project compiler-rt portion is Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception. See sources.lock.json license fields and docs/audits/puredarwin-reuse.md.

isolation: Target executables link only the source-built runtime; the macOS host runtime and dyld shared cache are never copied. llvm-project supplies compiler-rt builtins only, via the sparse paths recorded in sources.lock.json.

rebuild.note: Pins are validated by scripts/build/packages.py. A clean-environment rebuild with artifact comparison against a recorded runtime provenance receipt is remaining work.
